SELECT u.id, u.type, u.fullname, u.mobile, le.completion_status as completionStatus FROM user u LEFT JOIN learner_enrollment le ON u.id = le.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON le.course_id = c.id WHERE u.type = 'LEARNER' and le.course_id = #{courseId} and c.is_in_progress = 1 ORDER BY ${pageUserReqDTO.orderBy} ${pageUserReqDTO.orderDirection}
LIMIT #{pageUserReqDTO.offset}, #{pageUserReqDTO.pageSize}
mapper.sql: SELECT u.id FROM user u LEFT JOIN staff_detail sd ON sd.user_id = u.id WHERE u.type = 'ADMINISTRATOR' AND sd.position = 'GENERAL_MANAGER'
